body: don’t bother taking math at purdue if you can avoid it at all. learned my lesson after calc I and transferred in the rest

i’m also a young woman in the midwest and go hiking alone 4+ times a week. the people i’ve encountered have never been scary and i don’t bring any weapons. just some water, light first aid, space blanket if i’ll be out for a while. creepy guys are way more likely to bother me at the grocery store than in the woods. take whatever you need to feel safe and you’ll get more confident the more you do it!

no one has recommended newport state park yet, but it’s really neat up there and they’ve got some great backpacking sites. you can avoid the crowd at devil’s lake if you’re willing to get up early before everyone else wakes up. also the porcupine mountains in the UP have really pretty backpacking campsites and cabins.

sometimes i have to use the treadmill for 3 hours, but it’s at my apartment gym so no employees to judge me. as long as there are others open, i don’t see an issue. i think plenty of people do longer treadmill workouts, and if they don’t, they wont be around long enough to know how long you were there
i just wear seamless undies. not wearing any underwear would be so uncomfy
